purpose: controlled baseline stage 1 reproduction check (matched ruler, seed 42)
metric: P@10% = precision of top max(1, floor(0.1*flagged)) findings

cache_mismatch_cause.finding: cache (09-03) and seeded (09-04) have identical flagged/tp per condition (29/29) but different severities; the cache severities are reproduced exactly (29/29 conditions, sorted severity multiset) when rescoring under AIDA_RELIABILITY_PROFILE=experiment/reliability_profile_mc.json, and 0/29 without it
cache_mismatch_cause.check: evaluate_box_accuracy.load_cached_rows on the cache (no GPU): without profile -> P@10 equals seeded 29/29; with reliability_profile_mc.json -> 22/29 (= cache stored order)
cache_mismatch_cause.conclusion: the 7.2-2 cache-vs-seeded gap is a severity-constant (reliability profile) difference, not inference, image selection or ordering. seeded_*.json were produced with default constants (no profile) and severity-only ordering

cache_profile_survey.method: recompute severity_for(suspicion, raw_signal, is_present in cached present_types, confidence) for every cached verdict; tolerance 1e-3; no GPU
cache_profile_survey.implication: all multi-class verdict caches and their box_accuracy_eval_mc*.json were made with AIDA_RELIABILITY_PROFILE=reliability_profile_mc.json; seeded_ruler4_7seeds.json (matched, seed 42) was made without it
